==Overview==
The '''2025 ACS Season 2'''  (Korean: 2025 챌린저스 스타리그(ACS) 시즌2) is an online tournament for amateur players organized by SOOP.

==Format==
*'''Qualifiers'''
**4 single-elimination brackets.
**Winner of each bracket advances to the Main Event.
*'''Main Event'''
**Single-elimination bracket.
**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}}.
